verdict.rationale: OpenCode explicitly supports configuring any LLM provider via API keys, lists 75+ providers through Models.dev including local models, offers a curated OpenCode Zen model list, and supports logging in with GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT Plus/Pro accounts. Community evidence corroborates real-world use with multiple providers (Claude, Gemini, local llama.cpp, Qwen) and per-agent model selection. Missing for 10: some community reports note model/provider switching across sessions can be buggy or annoying, a minor UX caveat.
